<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<plist version="1.0">
  <dict>
    <!-- Native empty typed metadata must survive without changing its source spelling. -->
    <key>dock.empty</key>
    <dict>
      <key>NSStringLocalizedFormatKey</key>
      <string>%#@signals@ across the inlet</string>
      <key>signals</key>
      <dict>
        <key>NSStringFormatSpecTypeKey</key><string>NSStringPluralRuleType</string>
        <key>NSStringFormatValueTypeKey</key><string>ld</string>
        <key>one</key><string>%ld visible beacon</string>
        <key>other</key><string><![CDATA[%ld visible beacons]]></string>
        <!-- Rule-owned zero-length data is legal only with an explicit end tag. -->
        <key>futureRuleData</key><data></data>
      </dict>

      <!-- Literal <data/> inside comments must not be mistaken for a typed tag. -->
      <?native preserve="literal <data/> marker"?>
      <!-- Whitespace inside explicit data is ignored by native base64 decoding. -->
      <key>futureEmptyData</key><data></data>
      <key>futureWhitespaceData</key><data> 	
      </data>
      <key>futurePayload</key><data>YQ==</data>

      <!-- Both self-closing and explicit empty collections are native-valid. -->
      <key>futureEmptyArray</key><array />
      <key>futureExplicitArray</key><array></array>
      <key>futureEmptyDictionary</key><dict />
      <key>futureExplicitDictionary</key><dict></dict>

      <!-- Empty string and boolean representations retain their original bytes. -->
      <key>futureEmptyString</key><string />
      <key>futureExplicitString</key><string></string>
      <key>futureLiteralMarker</key><string><![CDATA[Literal <data/> remains visible]]></string>
      <key>futureTrue</key><true></true>
      <key>futureFalse</key><false/>

      <!-- Nested containers have the same explicit-only empty-data contract. -->
      <key>futureStructured</key>
      <array>
        <data></data>
        <dict><key>nestedEmptyData</key><data></data></dict>
        <array></array>
      </array>
    </dict>
  </dict>
</plist>
